archetype: Archetype 5 (Luxury - Premium, Depth, Mystery) combined with High-Contrast Swiss

colors.notes: Transitioning away from the generic emerald green to a deeply cinematic 'Obsidian & Champagne' luxury palette. Colors must remain strictly high-contrast. Never use pure #000000; use #050505 (deepest charcoal/void) for backgrounds.

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter). Avoid standard 'Bold' everywhere—use Light for elegant over-sized text and Black/Bold for impactful words.

body.usage: Clean, highly readable geometric body copy.

mono.usage: For VIN numbers, pricing, specs, and dashboard metrics.

labels.usage: Overlines above headings, table column headers, form labels.

visual_enhancers.gradients: No generic full-screen gradients. Use extreme low-opacity radial glows (#C5A880/5) purely to highlight specific UI elements like featured car cards.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use CSS noise or subtle grain overlays to prevent digital flatness. Gives a physical 'showroom' or 'matte paint' feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used strictly for the sticky header and floating action bars. Must use backdrop-blur-xl, bg-black/60, and a delicate border-white/10 to create 'milled crystal' optics. No muddy grays.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px solid borders (border-border) everywhere to maintain a rigid, technical, yet premium feel.

public_site.hero: Cinematic. 100vh or max-h-[800px]. Full bleed image with bg-black/40 to bg-black/60 overlay. Text must be legible. H1 should not exceed text-6xl.
public_site.grids: Use 'Bento Grid' (Mode A: Asymmetry). Wide gaps (gap-8). Feature the hero car in col-span-8, supporting details in col-span-4.
public_site.cards: Flat surfaces with 1px border. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle ambient shadow, and border color lightens to border-white/20.
public_site.spacing: Generous spacing. py-24 or py-32 for sections.

admin_dashboard.layout: F-Pattern High-Density Layout. Collapsible left sidebar navigation (bg-surface).
admin_dashboard.metrics: Top row should be metric cards (MRR, Total Listings, Submissions).
admin_dashboard.tables: Data-heavy, high contrast. Use Shadcn tables with sticky headers. Text sizes text-sm. Mono font for IDs/prices.
admin_dashboard.spacing: Tight spacing (gap-4 or gap-6). Utilize all pixels. Height-full on children.

components.buttons: Sharp edges or minimal radius (rounded-sm). Primary button uses the Champagne accent (bg-accent text-primary-foreground). Hover state must be lighter.
components.forms: Never use native HTML inputs. Use Shadcn Input, Select, Textarea. Inputs should have bg-surface, border-border, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent focus:border-accent.
components.tabs_and_pills: Use for filtering listings (All, SUVs, Coupes). Override Shadcn tab list fixed heights to h-auto.
components.toasts: Use Sonner. Ensure toast backgrounds match the dark luxury theme (bg-surface, border-border, text-primary).

motion.hover_states: All interactive elements MUST have transition-colors duration-200. Cards need transition-transform duration-300.
motion.entrances: Staggered fade-up for vehicle listings. Page transitions should be smooth.
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for an 'Editorial Ribbon' of luxury brands (e.g., Porsche • Mercedes-Benz • Audi • BMW) moving slowly across a section.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text over images uses text-shadow or a gradient overlay behind the text. Gray text must meet 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent focus:outline-none).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-car-button').

images.note: Use these strictly for hero images, placeholder car listings, and section backgrounds. Do not use placehold.it.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this JSON and implement a highly polished, cinematic 'dark-luxe' UI.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn colors; override CSS variables to match the colors listed here (#050505 bg, #121212 surface, #C5A880 accent).
Make the Admin Dashboard feel like a high-end command center. Use the 'F-Pattern' layout with a sidebar and dense data grids.
In the public site, ensure hero images have a bg-black/50 overlay so the Outfit typography pops.
Add data-testid attributes to all form elements, buttons, and critical links.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Do not center everything. Use asymmetry.
Do not apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs.
Use modern button styles (sharp or rounded-sm) with interaction animations.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings).
